verdict.rationale: Rainforest is a payfac-as-a-service platform, so seller tax reporting is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence pack never mentions 1099-K threshold tracking, form generation, delivery, IRS filing, or a corrections workflow. SSN collection during onboarding and KYC/KYB checks are adjacent onboarding features, not tax reporting, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a finance lead, seller tax reporting is handled — 1099-K thresholds tracked, forms generated, delivered, and filed, with the data corrections workflow documented
